name: Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that relationships are essential to human flourishing, as God declared it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The union of husband and wife is designed to be a lasting, unbreakable bond where two become one flesh (Genesis 2:24; Ecclesiastes 4:12). True friendship and family ties demonstrate steadfast love and support, especially in times of adversity (Proverbs 17:17), underscoring the strength found in godly connections.
